# CP-4 Forward-Wiring Master Checklist (#1082, tape-authoritative training)

> **Historical snapshot, not current operating guidance.** This document records
> migration state from May 2026. The `KILN_USE_TAPE_*` and
> `KILN_USE_TAPE_AUTHORITATIVE` switches mentioned below were removed without
> aliases or replacement fields. Current GPU training uses an internal tape
> scope as its sole routing authority. See [Configuration](./CONFIGURATION.md)
> and [Native SFT Profile](./NATIVE_SFT_PROFILE.md) for current behavior.

This is the authoritative wiring plan for the tape-authoritative training forward pass (prefill, `seq_len>1`, F32 tiny model on CUDA, all 7 tape gates on). It maps every op on the `cross_entropy → embedding` loss→input path, groups the unwired ops into monotonic-coverage increments, and lists the new adapters and chaining hazards. The measured starting state is `tape_has_grad=0/50` LoRA Vars (~5% of the forward wired).

The single most important structural fact: **`backend.linear_prefill_apply` → `cuda.rs:1759` (`x2d.matmul(weight_t)`) is the universal base-matmul site** for every projection (q/k/v/o, gate/up/down, GDN in_proj_qkv/z/a/b, GDN out_proj) AND the lm_head. On the F32 training path `cuda_lora_linear_training_bf16` returns `None` (BF16-only guard) and `track_op()` is true, so `linear_with_lora_t_backend_decode_if:3451` always routes here. Wiring this one site (as a tape node on the `linear_prefill_apply` output, chaining `tape_kt_input(x)`) closes the largest single class of breaks. The `broadcast_matmul_cpu_compatible` / `matmul_no_broadcast_copy` / `try_kt_matmul` sites the region maps point at are **dead code on the training path** and must NOT be the wiring target.

## 2. Shippable increments (monotonic coverage growth)

Each increment extends the connected tape strictly further from the loss, so `[CP4-COVERAGE] tape_has_grad=N/50` climbs every PR. Order is loss-first.

### Increment 1 — Loss-side scalar ops (connect loss → lm_head output)
- **Wires:** to_f32_dtype@trainer.rs:5968, index_select@5961, narrow@5936, squeeze@5932.
- **Adapters to add:** NEW try_tape_cast_cuda, NEW try_tape_index_select_cuda, NEW try_tape_narrow_cuda, NEW try_tape_unsqueeze_cuda (squeeze = unsqueeze inverse). All four BackwardOps already exist in kiln-autograd.
- **Coverage delta:** 0 new LoRA Vars yet (lm_head matmul still unwired), but connects cross_entropy down to the lm_head output reshape — prerequisite for every Var.
- **Parity:** loss value unchanged; `tape_has_grad` stays 0 but the tape island now reaches cuda.rs:1762.

### Increment 2 — lm_head matmul + its reshapes (first Var-bearing connection)
- **Wires:** lm_head matmul@cuda.rs:1759, input reshape@~1755, output reshape@1762; chain into final rms_norm@21858.
- **Adapters:** NEW try_tape_lm_head_cuda (MatmulBackward over hidden@embed_t) wired into `linear_prefill_apply` when track_op; try_tape_reshape_cuda for both reshapes.
- **Coverage delta:** lm_head is tied weights to embedding (no separate LoRA Var), but this connects the loss to the final RMSNorm → the spine that all per-layer Vars hang off. After this, the topmost layer's Vars become reachable once Increment 3 lands.
- **Parity:** logits bit-identical; grad of final rms_norm weight matches candle baseline.

### Increment 3 — Universal base-matmul tape node (the big unlock)
- **Wires:** the single `linear_with_lora_t_backend_decode_if:3451 → linear_prefill_apply → cuda.rs:1759` site, which serves ALL of q/k/v/o, gate/up/down, GDN in_proj_qkv/z/a/b, GDN out_proj.
- **Adapters:** NEW try_tape_linear_base (MatmulBackward; record base node, chain `tape_kt_input(x)`, retain output so the immediately-following try_tape_lora_add_cuda@2466 reuses it instead of fresh-borrowing). Effectively makes the existing 30+ partial `try_tape_lora_add_cuda` sites become fully-connected in one change.
- **Coverage delta:** the LARGEST jump. Every LoRA add whose `x` is already on a wired norm output now chains through. Expected to bring the full-attn projection Vars (q/k/v/o per GQA layer) + MLP Vars (gate/up/down) into reach as soon as the intervening layout ops (Increments 4-5) are wired. Partial today → wired.
- **Parity:** per-projection weight grad + LoRA A/B grad match candle baseline for one layer.

### Increment 4 — Full-attn residuals + reshape/transpose layout chain
- **Wires:** attn residual@20707 + FFN residual@20726 (swap raw `+` → residual_add()); q/k/v reshape@17437/17450/17451; SwiGLU mul@11019 (NEW try_tape_mul_cuda); cuda_silu@11008 chain.
- **Adapters:** reuse try_tape_add_cuda (via residual_add), try_tape_reshape_cuda, NEW try_tape_mul_cuda; try_tape_silu_cuda already wired.
- **Coverage delta:** connects the full-attn MLP Vars (gate/up/down on the 8 GQA layers) and the q/k/v Vars up to the SDPA boundary. tape_has_grad climbs by the full-attn MLP + the q/k/v projection Vars whose norm-spine is now connected top-down.
- **Parity:** full-attn layer MLP block grad parity; q/k/v LoRA grad parity up to SDPA input.

### Increment 5 — Naive SDPA fallback node + attn transposes (full-attn o_proj reach)
- **Wires:** naive SDPA block@17647-17722 (score/mask/softmax/value/out-transpose) as a single fused node; q/k/v transpose@17563-17566; GQA k/v expand@17614-17621.
- **Adapters:** wire try_tape_sdpa_fallback_cuda into the `gqa_attention_pre_o` naive path (currently dead — only reachable via core_prefill/streaming); try_tape_transpose_cuda; NEW try_tape_gqa_expand_cuda.
- **Coverage delta:** completes the full-attn path end-to-end → o_proj Vars reachable, and RoPE/q_norm/k_norm (already wired) now connected. All 8 GQA layers' Vars fully covered.
- **Parity:** full-attn layer end-to-end grad parity vs candle.

### Increment 6 — GDN conv1d + post-conv layout (unlock GDN spine)
- **Wires:** causal_conv1d_prefill@15656 (call the EXISTING try_tape_causal_conv1d_cuda); conv transposes@15601/15671; cuda_silu@15662 chain; QKV split narrow+reshape@15695-15704; z reshape@15704; head_expand@15873-15878.
- **Adapters:** wire try_tape_causal_conv1d_cuda (exists, 0 call sites); try_tape_transpose_cuda; NEW try_tape_narrow_cuda; try_tape_reshape_cuda; NEW try_tape_unsqueeze_cuda.
- **Coverage delta:** connects GDN in_proj_qkv/z LoRA Vars through conv to qk_norm + gated_rms_norm (both already wired). Large jump for the 24 GDN layers.
- **Parity:** GDN conv + qk_norm + gated_norm grad parity; in_proj_qkv/z LoRA grad parity.

### Increment 7 — GDN gates + recurrence prep (complete GDN, reach in_proj_a/b)
- **Wires:** gates fallback beta@16296 + g@16300; recur_prep transposes@16396-16400; v to_dtype@16393; reshape@16564 + to_dtype@16565 before out_proj.
- **Adapters:** NEW try_tape_gdn_gates_cuda (fused g composite) + NEW try_tape_sigmoid_cuda (or fold beta into gates node); try_tape_transpose_cuda; NEW try_tape_cast_cuda; try_tape_reshape_cuda. This makes tape_record_gdn_recurrent@16456 stop silently no-opping (its q/k/v/beta/g inputs now have kt ids) and connects out_proj.
- **Coverage delta:** final jump — GDN in_proj_a/b reachable through gates→recurrence; GDN out_proj reachable through reshape/to_dtype. **Target: tape_has_grad=50/50.**
- **Parity:** full GDN layer end-to-end grad parity; full-model loss grad parity vs candle baseline.

### Increment 8 (gated, conditional) — long-context + output-gate coverage
- **Wires:** chunked-MLP narrow@10605 + cat@10633-10636 (NEW try_tape_cat_dim1_cuda); q/gate split@17425-17432 for output-gate configs.
- **Coverage delta:** 0 for the default tiny model (off-path); required before enabling long-context (seq_len>1024) training or output-gate model variants. Ship only when those configs are exercised.

## 3. NEW ADAPTERS NEEDED

Adapters that do not exist in tape_forward.rs today, with backward math and chaining notes. `tape_kt_input(x)` reuse + `retain_output_for_chaining(out_kt, out.id())` is mandatory for every one.

| adapter | op | backward math | chaining notes |
|---------|----|--------------|----------------|
| try_tape_cast_cuda | to_dtype / to_f32_dtype (trainer.rs:5968, forward.rs:16393/16565) | CastBackward: grad passes through with dtype cast back to input dtype (identity in value space; bf16↔f32 round-trip). BackwardOp exists in kiln-autograd. | Must register the *original* input id, not the cast result. On LoRA-Var casts the original Var id must be preserved (else grad lands on a_bf16, not proj.a — the silent CudaLoraLinearBf16 bug). |
| try_tape_index_select_cuda | index_select dim0 (trainer.rs:5961) | IndexSelectBackward: scatter-add grad rows back to selected indices, zero elsewhere. Exists in kiln-autograd. | Indices non-diff; map source tensor only. |
| try_tape_narrow_cuda | narrow / slice (trainer.rs:5936, GDN QKV split 15695-15704, GDN v 16393, chunked MLP 10605, output-gate split 17426) | NarrowBackward: pad grad with zeros outside the narrowed window. Exists in kiln-autograd. | High-frequency: appears in GDN split AND loss-side AND chunked MLP. One adapter covers all. |
| try_tape_unsqueeze_cuda | unsqueeze / squeeze (forward.rs:21759, 15873; trainer.rs:5932 as inverse) | UnsqueezeBackward: squeeze the inserted/removed dim from grad. Exists in kiln-autograd. | squeeze(0) = unsqueeze inverse; reuse same BackwardOp with adjoint flip. Could alternatively express via try_tape_reshape_cuda. |
| try_tape_lm_head_cuda | hidden@embed_t → logits (cuda.rs:1759, reached via lm_head_forward_backend_decode_if:11795) | MatmulBackward: dL/dhidden = dL/dlogits @ embed; dL/dembed accumulates (tied weights → flows into embedding Var). | Must fire when track_op (the real training path); `try_kt_lm_head`/`broadcast_matmul` are dead here. Chain from final rms_norm output. |
| try_tape_linear_base | x@weight_t base projection (cuda.rs:1759, the universal site reached via linear_with_lora_t_backend_decode_if:3451) | MatmulBackward: dL/dx = dL/dy @ weight; dL/dweight = x^T @ dL/dy (weight frozen for LoRA → x-grad is the load-bearing output). | THE keystone. Record base node, retain output so the following try_tape_lora_add_cuda@2466 reuses it instead of fresh-borrowing x_2d. Consider folding base+LoRA into one try_tape_lora_linear_cuda node to avoid the reshape-boundary fresh-borrow entirely. |
| try_tape_mul_cuda | gate * up elementwise (forward.rs:11019) | MulBackward: dL/da = dL/dy * b; dL/db = dL/dy * a. | Same-shape elementwise. The production SwiGLU mul (try_tape_swiglu_cuda is dead on this path). |
| try_tape_gdn_gates_cuda | g = -exp(a_log) * softplus(a + dt_bias) (forward.rs:16300, fallback:13729) | Composite backward: d/da through softplus (sigmoid(a+dt_bias)) and exp chain; record as one fused node (candle composite analytic grad). | Fold beta=sigmoid(b) in too (or separate try_tape_sigmoid_cuda). Inputs: a (from in_proj_a), b (from in_proj_b). Connects in_proj_a/b LoRA → recurrence. |
| try_tape_sigmoid_cuda | beta = sigmoid(b) (forward.rs:16296, fallback:13717) | SigmoidBackward: dL/dx = dL/dy * y*(1-y). | Optional if folded into try_tape_gdn_gates_cuda. Severs in_proj_b otherwise. |
| try_tape_gqa_expand_cuda | unsqueeze+expand+contiguous+reshape for GQA k/v head replication (forward.rs:17614-17621; GDN head_expand 15873-15878) | ExpandBackward: sum grad over the replicated (broadcast) head dim back to kv_heads. | Only when num_heads≠num_kv_heads (Qwen3.5-4B: 16 q / 4 kv → always on). Could compose unsqueeze+reshape adapters + an expand-sum node. |
| try_tape_cat_dim1_cuda | cat / try_kt_cat_dim1 chunked-MLP reassembly (forward.rs:10633-10636) | ConcatBackward: split grad along dim1 back to each chunk. | Off-path for tiny model; required for long-context (Increment 8). |

Reuse-existing (no new adapter, just new call sites): try_tape_reshape_cuda, try_tape_transpose_cuda, try_tape_add_cuda (via residual_add()), try_tape_silu_cuda, try_tape_causal_conv1d_cuda (exists @1897, 0 call sites — wire at 15656), try_tape_sdpa_fallback_cuda (exists @2433 but dead — wire into pre_o naive path).

## 4. CHAINING HAZARDS

Every layout/dtype op that mints a new candle id on the loss path and must be wrapped (or eliminated) to keep the chain connected. An unwrapped hazard severs everything upstream even when values are bit-correct.

| hazard | site | kind | must do |
|--------|------|------|---------|
| to_f32_dtype before cross_entropy | trainer.rs:5968 | dtype cast | wrap try_tape_cast_cuda |
| index_select active rows | trainer.rs:5961 | gather | wrap try_tape_index_select_cuda |
| narrow shift logits | trainer.rs:5936 | slice | wrap try_tape_narrow_cuda |
| squeeze(0) logits | trainer.rs:5932 | layout | wrap try_tape_unsqueeze_cuda |
| lm_head input/output reshape | cuda.rs:~1755 / 1762 | reshape | wrap try_tape_reshape_cuda (inside linear_prefill_apply) |
| unsqueeze(0) after embedding | forward.rs:21759 | layout | wrap try_tape_unsqueeze_cuda |
| full-attn attn residual (raw +) | forward.rs:20707 | add | replace with residual_add() (wraps try_tape_add_cuda) |
| full-attn FFN residual (raw +) | forward.rs:20726 | add | replace with residual_add() |
| gate*up SwiGLU mul (raw *) | forward.rs:11019 | mul | wrap try_tape_mul_cuda |
| q/k/v reshape (full-attn) | forward.rs:17437/17450/17451 | reshape | wrap try_tape_reshape_cuda |
| q/k/v transpose+contiguous (SDPA) | forward.rs:17563-17566 | transpose | wrap try_tape_transpose_cuda |
| q/k/v contiguous (flash, BF16) | forward.rs:17509-17511 | contiguous | wrap try_tape_transpose_cuda (contiguous = layout identity) — BF16-only |
| GQA k/v expand chain | forward.rs:17614-17621 | unsqueeze+expand+reshape | wrap try_tape_gqa_expand_cuda |
| attn out transpose+contiguous+reshape | forward.rs:17722 | transpose+reshape | wrap try_tape_transpose_cuda + try_tape_reshape_cuda |
| q/gate split (output-gate models) | forward.rs:17425-17432 | reshape+narrow+contiguous | wrap try_tape_narrow_cuda + try_tape_reshape_cuda (gate-on only) |
| GDN conv layout transpose (in) | forward.rs:15601 | transpose | wrap try_tape_transpose_cuda |
| GDN post-conv transpose (out) | forward.rs:15671 | transpose | wrap try_tape_transpose_cuda |
| GDN QKV split narrow+reshape | forward.rs:15695/15698/15701 | narrow+reshape | wrap try_tape_narrow_cuda + try_tape_reshape_cuda |
| GDN z reshape | forward.rs:15704 | reshape | wrap try_tape_reshape_cuda |
| GDN head_expand unsqueeze+expand+reshape | forward.rs:15873-15878 | unsqueeze+expand+reshape | wrap try_tape_unsqueeze_cuda + try_tape_reshape_cuda (+ expand-sum) |
| GDN v to_dtype before recurrence | forward.rs:16393 | dtype cast | wrap try_tape_cast_cuda |
| GDN recur_prep transposes (q/k/v/beta/g) | forward.rs:16396-16400 | transpose ×5 | wrap try_tape_transpose_cuda (each) |
| GDN post-gated-norm reshape | forward.rs:16564 | reshape | wrap try_tape_reshape_cuda |
| GDN post-gated-norm to_dtype | forward.rs:16565 | dtype cast | wrap try_tape_cast_cuda |
| chunked-MLP narrow / cat | forward.rs:10605 / 10633-10636 | slice / concat | wrap try_tape_narrow_cuda + try_tape_cat_dim1_cuda (long-context only) |
| LoRA-add x_2d fresh borrow | tape_forward.rs:990-1008 | reshape boundary | fix try_tape_lora_add_cuda to `tape_kt_input(x_2d)` after wrapping the reshape, OR fold base+LoRA into try_tape_lora_linear_cuda |
| LoRA Var to_dtype (a_bf16/b_bf16) | forward.rs:2637-2638 / 2709-2721 | dtype cast | register original proj.a.id()/proj.b.id(), not the cast id (the CudaLoraLinearBf16 silent-grad-loss bug) |

**Systemic trap — track_op-gated "fast paths" that turn OFF during training.** These are NOT wiring targets; the real training op is the un-fused candle fallback each falls back to. Do not mark anything "wired" because one of these exists:
- try_tape_swiglu_cuda@10438 — gated `!gate.track_op() && !up.track_op()`@10424 + only in swiglu_ffn_gated_hidden (not the prod swiglu_ffn path). Dead. Real op: cuda_silu@11008 + mul@11019.
- fused gates kernel@16289 — gated `gdn_forward_only_fastpaths = allow && !x.track_op()`@15267/16289. Dead in training. Real op: gated_deltanet_gates_fallback@13717/13729.
- fused MLP silu*mul@10963-10984 / 10963 — BF16 + `!x.track_op()`. Dead. Real op: silu+mul candle.
- try_kt_lm_head@11702 / broadcast_matmul lm_head@6216 — only when track_op=false. Dead. Real op: linear_prefill_apply→cuda.rs:1759.
- try_kt_matmul@6253 / broadcast_matmul_cpu_compatible@6172 — only when no backend / track_op=false. Dead. Real op: linear_prefill_apply→cuda.rs:1759.
- try_tape_sdpa_fallback_cuda@17107 (in core_prefill/streaming) — off below 2048 tokens + transformer_block_detached early-exits on track_op@20748. Dead. Real op: naive SDPA@17647-17722 in gqa_attention_pre_o.

## 5. VALIDATION

- **Coverage test:** `crates/kiln-train/src/trainer.rs::tape_authoritative_grads_match_candle_baseline` — emits `[CP4-COVERAGE] tape_has_grad=N/50` and checks grad parity vs the candle baseline. Watch N climb monotonically across Increments 1→7 (target 50/50).
- **Run:** `cargo nextest run -p kiln-train --features cuda` on an A6000 pod (acquire via `ce kiln-pod-acquire --gpu-type 'NVIDIA RTX A6000'`; never `until ssh` polling — use `wait-file --timeout`). Per-increment, also run a single-layer parity check before the full 50-Var test to localize breaks.
- **Per-increment gate:** each PR must (a) keep loss bit-identical (forward values unchanged — tape is record-only), (b) raise or hold `tape_has_grad`, (c) pass grad parity for the newly-connected Vars vs candle.
- **Default-on flip:** `trainer.rs:10601` `unwrap_or(false)` → `unwrap_or(true)`. Flip ONLY when `tape_has_grad==50/50` AND full-model grad parity passes. Until then keep gated behind `KILN_USE_TAPE_AUTHORITATIVE`.
- **Build hygiene:** GDN kernel SASS can go stale in sccache (cudaErrorSymbolNotFound 500). Preface pod builds with `cargo clean -p kiln-gdn-kernel && SCCACHE_RECACHE=1`. Build release + `--features cuda`, `KILN_CUDA_ARCHS=86`.
